verdict.rationale: Relay only claims one-way syncing of categorized expenses/receipts to accounting software (relay-docs-3), not true bidirectional real-time ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries; no mention of ERP-specific integrations (NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics) or two-way ledger reconciliation. Missing for 10: bidirectional sync mechanics, named ERP integrations, evidence of eliminating manual journal entries, independent confirmation of real-time accuracy.
